id: 07_Safety Showers and Eye Washes in the Laboratory - [Employee Training]
title: 紧急淋浴和洗眼器
source_doc: course/Fire Safety & Extinguisher Training/07_Safety Showers and Eye Washes in the Laboratory - [Employee Training].md
author_source: project/Fire Safety & Extinguisher Training/07_Safety Showers and Eye Washes in the Laboratory - [Employee Training]/src.py

points.K1: 意外难免，快速冲洗是关键
points.K2: 一个动作即开，持续出水
points.K3: 淋浴：立即浇透，持续供水
points.K4: 洗眼器：柔和水流，持续供水
points.K5: 有危险物质处就要配置
points.K9: 通道和淋浴区保持畅通
points.K10: 定期放水测试，随时可用
points.K12: 被溅到：别慌，呼救，去冲洗
points.K13: 帮助者：让伤员彻底浇透
points.K17: 继续冲洗，总时长不少于15分钟
points.K20: 污染衣物先去污或废弃
points.K25: 别把污染冲进另一只眼
points.K27: 便携式洗眼器只作初步冲洗
points.K28: 手持软管不能当洗眼器
points.K29: 洗眼瓶只在别无他法时用
points.K30: 用后就医，每次都要报告

shots.scene: 欣欣站在紧急淋浴和洗眼器旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a combination safety shower and eyewash station and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲紧急淋浴和洗眼器。

shots.scene: 紧急淋浴标志和洗眼器标志并排
shots.prompt_en: A safety shower sign and an eyewash sign side by side on a white wall. No people.
shots.narration: 找得到、打得开、冲得够。

shots.scene: 阿杰在台前倒试剂，液体溅起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing a lab coat and safety glasses, pours a liquid at a bench and a small splash jumps up.
shots.narration: 阿杰倒试剂时，液体溅了出来。

shots.scene: 阿杰捂着眼睛原地打转
shots.prompt_en: The young male student covers his eyes with both hands and turns around in confusion.
shots.narration: 他捂着眼睛，一下子慌了。

shots.scene: 小研拉着阿杰快步走向洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes the young male student by the arm and leads him quickly to an eyewash station.
shots.narration: 小研马上把他带到洗眼器。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 最初几秒的冲洗，最关键。

shots.section_title: 意外难免，快速冲洗是关键
shots.scene: 小研穿好实验服、戴护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves at the lab entrance.
shots.narration: 我们穿戴防护，谨慎选用器材。
overlay: 意外难免，快速冲洗是关键

shots.section_title: 意外难免，快速冲洗是关键
shots.scene: 倾倒的烧瓶图标，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tipping flask with a splash and a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 可意外总会发生。

shots.section_title: 意外难免，快速冲洗是关键
shots.scene: 淋浴和洗眼器图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a safety shower and an eyewash station glowing with a green halo. No people.
shots.narration: 这时快速冲洗，能大大减轻伤害。

shots.section_title: 一个动作即开，持续出水
shots.scene: 手拉下淋浴拉杆，水立即落下
shots.prompt_en: A hand pulls down the triangle handle of a safety shower and water pours out at once.
shots.narration: 好的设备，一个动作就出水。
overlay: 一个动作即开，持续出水

shots.section_title: 一个动作即开，持续出水
shots.scene: 松手后水仍在流，再推回拉杆才停
shots.prompt_en: The hand lets go and the water keeps flowing; then the handle is pushed back and the water stops. No people.
shots.narration: 松手也不停，再操作一次才关。

shots.section_title: 淋浴：立即浇透，持续供水
shots.scene: 淋浴喷头大量出水
shots.prompt_en: A safety shower head pours a strong full curtain of water. No people.
shots.narration: 淋浴水量要大，一下把人浇透。
overlay: 淋浴：立即浇透，持续供水

shots.section_title: 淋浴：立即浇透，持续供水
shots.scene: 淋浴旁一个计时器
shots.prompt_en: A safety shower running with a stopwatch icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 还要能连续供水至少15分钟。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器：柔和水流，持续供水
shots.scene: 洗眼器两个喷头冒出柔和水柱
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash station with two nozzles producing soft gentle aerated streams of water. No people.
shots.narration: 洗眼器的水流要柔和。
overlay: 洗眼器：柔和水流，持续供水

shots.section_title: 洗眼器：柔和水流，持续供水
shots.scene: 洗眼器旁一个计时器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash station running with a stopwatch icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 同样能持续至少15分钟。

shots.section_title: 有危险物质处就要配置
shots.scene: 走廊尽头一套淋浴洗眼一体装置
shots.prompt_en: A combination safety shower and eyewash station at the end of a lab corridor with a safety shower sign above it. No people.
shots.narration: 有危险物质的地方，就要配备。
overlay: 有危险物质处就要配置

shots.scene: 腐蚀性象形图下，手和眼睛图标变红
shots.prompt_en: A corrosive pictogram above a hand icon and an eye icon that turn red. No people.
shots.narration: 腐蚀品对皮肤和眼睛伤害最重。

shots.scene: 几个贴空白标签和腐蚀象形图的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Several reagent bottles with blank labels, each with a corrosive pictogram, on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 强酸、强碱、脱水剂、氧化剂都是。

shots.scene: 手背上缠绷带的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand with a bandage and a slow clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 酸灼伤很疼，愈合也慢。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标旁的碱性试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon with a red mark next to a bottle with a blank label and a corrosive pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 碱溅进眼睛，损伤更严重。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜手套拿着试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles, gloves and a lab coat, holds a reagent bottle.
shots.narration: 用这类物质，始终穿戴好防护。

shots.scene: 小研翻阅空白SDS文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet binder at a bench.
shots.narration: 先读SDS：成分、性质和危害。

shots.scene: 老周指着书架上空白的化学品安全计划
shots.prompt_en: The older man, a supervisor, points at a blank chemical safety plan binder on a shelf.
shots.narration: 单位的化学品安全计划，还有补充信息。

shots.scene: 实验室平面图上标出淋浴和洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: A simple floor plan of a lab with a shower icon and an eyewash icon marked by green dots. No people.
shots.narration: 要知道最近的淋浴和洗眼器在哪。

shots.scene: 阿杰闭着眼，沿着台边走到洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks with his eyes closed, one hand along the bench edge, and reaches the eyewash station.
shots.narration: 最好闭着眼也能摸过去。

shots.scene: 小研给阿杰演示如何打开洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shows the young male student how to push the paddle of an eyewash station.
shots.narration: 还要会用，知道怎么打开。

shots.section_title: 通道和淋浴区保持畅通
shots.scene: 洗眼器前堆着纸箱，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash station blocked by stacked cardboard boxes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通往淋浴和洗眼器的路，不能堵。
overlay: 通道和淋浴区保持畅通

shots.section_title: 通道和淋浴区保持畅通
shots.scene: 阿杰搬走纸箱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries the cardboard boxes away from the eyewash station.
shots.narration: 设备和物资，别堆在路上。

shots.section_title: 通道和淋浴区保持畅通
shots.scene: 淋浴下方地面空空的
shots.prompt_en: The area under a safety shower is clear and empty with a marked square on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 淋浴下面也要保持空旷。

shots.section_title: 定期放水测试，随时可用
shots.scene: 老李拉下淋浴拉手，下方大桶接水
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls the safety shower handle while a large bucket under it catches the water.
shots.narration: 认证机构要求定期做放水测试。
overlay: 定期放水测试，随时可用

shots.section_title: 定期放水测试，随时可用
shots.scene: 老李按下洗眼器推板放水
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes the eyewash paddle and watches both streams flow evenly.
shots.narration: 洗眼器也一样，看水流是否正常。

shots.section_title: 定期放水测试，随时可用
shots.scene: 日历上圈出几个日期，旁边淋浴图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with several dates circled, beside a shower icon. No people.
shots.narration: 主管或安全经理排计划，保证随时可用。

shots.scene: 龙头流出的水从浑浊变清
shots.prompt_en: Water coming out of a tap changes from cloudy brown to clear. No people.
shots.narration: 水要是可饮用水，不是滞留的积水。

shots.scene: 老李在淋浴旁的空白检查牌上签字
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer writes on a blank inspection tag hanging beside the safety shower.
shots.narration: 结果写在检查牌上，注明日期并签名。

shots.section_title: 被溅到：别慌，呼救，去冲洗
shots.scene: 阿杰被溅到，愣在原地
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gets splashed on his sleeve and freezes for a moment.
shots.narration: 被危险物质溅到，先别慌。
overlay: 被溅到：别慌，呼救，去冲洗

shots.section_title: 被溅到：别慌，呼救，去冲洗
shots.scene: 阿杰大声呼救
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shouts for help with one hand raised.
shots.narration: 大声呼救，让旁人知道。

shots.section_title: 被溅到：别慌，呼救，去冲洗
shots.scene: 两个箭头分别指向淋浴和洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows from a person pictogram: one to a safety shower icon, one to an eyewash icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按溅到的范围，去淋浴或洗眼器。

shots.section_title: 帮助者：让伤员彻底浇透
shots.scene: 小研和老周扶阿杰站到淋浴下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man guide the young male student under the running safety shower.
shots.narration: 帮忙的人要主动，把伤员带到淋浴下。
overlay: 帮助者：让伤员彻底浇透

shots.section_title: 帮助者：让伤员彻底浇透
shots.scene: 水从头到脚浇透的示意
shots.prompt_en: A person outline under a shower with water lines covering from head to toe. No people.
shots.narration: 从头到脚，彻底浇透。

shots.section_title: 帮助者：让伤员彻底浇透
shots.scene: 两个帮手图标
shots.prompt_en: Two helper pictograms on either side of a shower icon. No people.
shots.narration: 通常需要两个人帮忙。

shots.scene: 阿杰在水流中摘下护目镜，向后上方摘
shots.prompt_en: Under the shower, the young male student removes his goggles by lifting the strap back over his head, eyes closed.
shots.narration: 摘除所有防护用品。

shots.scene: 眼镜前移擦过眼睛的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of glasses being pulled forward across the eyes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 摘眼镜要小心，别把污染带进眼睛。

shots.scene: 实验服、裤子图标带水滴，旁边只剩内衣的简笔轮廓
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab coat and trousers with drops on them being set aside, next to a simple outline figure. No people.
shots.narration: 衣物至少脱到只剩内衣，顾不上难为情。

shots.scene: 一双沾水滴的鞋图标
shots.prompt_en: A pair of shoes with drops on them. No people.
shots.narration: 别忘了把鞋也脱掉。

shots.scene: 淋浴下方地面被吸附条围起
shots.prompt_en: Yellow absorbent socks form a ring on the floor around the water under a safety shower. No people.
shots.narration: 淋浴下没有围堰，用吸附条围住废水。

shots.scene: 水向外流的箭头被吸附条挡住
shots.prompt_en: Water flow arrows spreading outward are stopped by an absorbent barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 防止污染四处扩散。

shots.section_title: 继续冲洗，总时长不少于15分钟
shots.scene: 伤员披着毛毯走向更衣室淋浴间
shots.prompt_en: A wrapped figure in a blanket is guided by the older man toward a changing room shower door.
shots.narration: 初步冲淋后，可到更衣室继续冲洗。
overlay: 继续冲洗，总时长不少于15分钟

shots.section_title: 继续冲洗，总时长不少于15分钟
shots.scene: 浴帘后的淋浴间，旁边计时器
shots.prompt_en: A closed shower curtain with water running behind it and a stopwatch icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 前后加起来，冲足15分钟以上。

shots.scene: 小研和老周被淋湿的袖子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man look at their wet sleeves after helping.
shots.narration: 帮忙的人难免也被淋湿。

shots.scene: 小研在水槽冲洗前臂，换上干净实验服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses her forearms at a lab sink and changes into a clean lab coat.
shots.narration: 化学品虽被稀释，也可能需要洗消。

shots.scene: 地上的废水和一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A puddle of shower water on the floor with a question mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 冲淋后的废水，不能随便处理。

shots.scene: 用过的吸附条和收集的水装进贴空白标签的密封桶
shots.prompt_en: Used absorbent socks and collected water go into a sealed drum with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 有时要作为化学废物处置。

shots.scene: 带辐射警示标志的地面区域被警戒带围起
shots.prompt_en: A floor area with a radiation warning sign is fenced off with barrier tape. No people.
shots.narration: 泄漏物是放射性的，尤其如此。

shots.section_title: 污染衣物先去污或废弃
shots.scene: 污染衣物装入贴空白标签的袋子
shots.prompt_en: Contaminated clothes go into a sealed bag with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 脱下的衣物，先去污再清洗。
overlay: 污染衣物先去污或废弃

shots.section_title: 污染衣物先去污或废弃
shots.scene: 密封的衣物袋放进危险废物收集桶
shots.prompt_en: The sealed clothes bag is placed into a hazardous waste collection bin. No people.
shots.narration: 泄漏物特别危险时，衣物直接废弃。

shots.scene: 淋浴下方的地漏特写，箭头指向两条管路
shots.prompt_en: A floor drain under a shower with two pipe arrows: one to a holding tank icon, one to a sewer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有地漏，要弄清它通向哪里。

shots.scene: 老周拿着空白报告单在办公桌前打电话
shots.prompt_en: The older man, a supervisor, makes a phone call at his desk with a blank report form.
shots.narration: 通向下水道，主管可能要通报外部机构。

shots.scene: 存水弯剖面图，里面存着水
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section diagram of a drain trap with water held in the bend. No people.
shots.narration: 存水弯里要一直保持有水。

shots.scene: 干涸的存水弯冒出气体，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A dry drain trap with gas lines rising into the room, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 否则下水道气体会冒进房间。

shots.scene: 老李往地漏里倒水
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pours a bucket of water into the floor drain under the shower.
shots.narration: 这些气体可能易燃，也可能有毒。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在洗眼器旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an eyewash station with a soft stream running.
shots.narration: 化学品溅进眼睛，要用洗眼器。

shots.scene: 柔和、连续的水流特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of two soft continuous aerated streams from eyewash nozzles. No people.
shots.narration: 水流柔和、连续，不伤眼睛。

shots.scene: 阿杰俯身在洗眼器上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends over the eyewash station with water flowing toward his eyes.
shots.narration: 第一时间赶到洗眼器。

shots.scene: 手指撑开眼睑的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of fingers holding the upper and lower eyelids open in a stream of water. No people.
shots.narration: 用手指撑开眼睑。

shots.scene: 水流冲到眼睑内侧的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram showing water reaching under and behind the eyelid. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睑下面和后面，都要冲到。

shots.section_title: 别把污染冲进另一只眼
shots.scene: 头部侧倾示意图，水从伤眼内角流向外侧
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a head tilted to one side so the water flows over the injured eye and away from the other eye. No people.
shots.narration: 只有一只眼被溅到时，
overlay: 别把污染冲进另一只眼

shots.section_title: 别把污染冲进另一只眼
shots.scene: 水流流向另一只眼的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water carrying contamination into the other eye, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别让水把污染带到另一只眼。

shots.scene: 洗眼器旁一个计时器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash station with a stopwatch icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 冲洗至少15分钟。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标旁的慢速时钟
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon with a slow clock icon and a small warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 感觉好了也别停，很多伤害来得慢。

shots.section_title: 便携式洗眼器只作初步冲洗
shots.scene: 一个便携式自流洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: A portable self-contained eyewash station with an eyewash sign on it. No people.
shots.narration: 有的便携式洗眼器，水量不够。
overlay: 便携式洗眼器只作初步冲洗

shots.section_title: 便携式洗眼器只作初步冲洗
shots.scene: 箭头从便携式洗眼器指向固定洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from a portable eyewash unit to a plumbed eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 只能先冲一下，再去冲足15分钟。

shots.section_title: 手持软管不能当洗眼器
shots.scene: 手持冲淋软管图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a handheld drench hose with a squeeze handle. No people.
shots.narration: 手持软管，大多要一直按住。
overlay: 手持软管不能当洗眼器

shots.section_title: 手持软管不能当洗眼器
shots.scene: 一只手按软管、腾不出手撑眼的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one hand squeezing a hose while the other cannot hold both eyes open, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 腾不出双手撑眼，不能当洗眼器。

shots.section_title: 洗眼瓶只在别无他法时用
shots.scene: 墙上的洗眼瓶挂盒
shots.prompt_en: A wall-mounted box holding an eyewash bottle with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 小洗眼瓶，别无他法时才用。
overlay: 洗眼瓶只在别无他法时用

shots.section_title: 洗眼瓶只在别无他法时用
shots.scene: 箭头从洗眼瓶指向洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from an eyewash bottle icon to an eyewash station icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用完立刻去有水的地方继续冲。

shots.section_title: 用后就医，每次都要报告
shots.scene: 红十字和医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A red cross icon with a hospital building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 淋浴和洗眼器只是急救，
overlay: 用后就医，每次都要报告

shots.section_title: 用后就医，每次都要报告
shots.scene: 小研陪阿杰去医院
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student accompanies the young male student out of the lab toward a waiting car.
shots.narration: 冲洗后要立即就医。

shots.section_title: 用后就医，每次都要报告
shots.scene: 阿杰在办公室向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man, his supervisor, in the lab office.
shots.narration: 每用一次，都必须报告主管。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风橱、移液器和洗眼器图标之间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands among icons of a fume hood, a pipette and an eyewash station.
shots.narration: 它们和通风橱一样，是基本设施。

shots.scene: 地图钉、畅通的通道、水滴、红十字四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a map pin, a clear path, a water drop and a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 知道位置、通道畅通、会冲、就医。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标旁的盾牌
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon protected by a shield icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 用好它们，能保住一双眼睛。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮着淋浴和洗眼器图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a safety shower and an eyewash station.
shots.narration: 知道位置，通道畅通。

shots.scene: 日历和空白检查牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a calendar and a blank inspection tag. No people.
shots.narration: 定期放水，检查记录。

shots.scene: 淋浴、衣物和秒表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a shower, a pile of removed clothes and a stopwatch. No people.
shots.narration: 身上溅到：浇透、脱衣、冲足15分钟。

shots.scene: 眼睛被撑开在柔和水流下，旁边秒表
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an eye held open under a soft stream with a stopwatch. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛溅到：撑开眼睑，冲足15分钟。

shots.scene: 空白报告单和红十字图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank report form and a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 冲洗之后，就医并报告主管。

shots.scene: 欣欣在干净的洗眼器和淋浴旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a clean eyewash station and safety shower.
shots.narration: 记住位置，学会使用，下次见！
